llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Reducto document-processing integration that uses Maton credentials and optional automation with clear user-approval safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown-only with no executable files shipped. Network access, Bash examples, SDK usage, and raw HTTP fallback are proportionate to an API integration and include credential-handling guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew and requires Maton login; this is expected for the integration and not hidden, but users should trust the Maton CLI source before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions default to read/list operations, require explicit approval for connection creation and writes, and warn against following instructions embedded in fetched third-party content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill documents persistent credential storage, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations, but frames them as user-approved actions with scoping, deletion, DENY_ALL network policy examples, and warnings about persistent forwarding.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities fit the stated purpose: parsing, extracting, splitting, uploading, and editing documents through Reducto via Maton. Sensitive document transfer to Reducto is explicitly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using Maton as a gateway to Reducto and sending selected documents to Reducto for processing. Review each document, connection, write, hosted function, trigger, and destination before approving it, because some options can store credentials, consume credits, or create ongoing automated data flows.
